title: 第12章 劫外福音乱心澜第13章 镜像军团堕劫临
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、劫烬余波·道统之争
新天衡台落成大典上，儒门清流派与权术派弟子因「仁劫剑」的解读爆发冲突：
-清流派：「仁道为基，劫术为辅，方合儒门正统！
-权术派：「若无劫术震慑，仁道何以行之？」
沈墨卿按住剑柄，道骨竹节的青铜纹路与七情道心珠同时发亮：「仁、权、劫三色并存，正喻儒道需兼容并蓄——即日起，儒门设「仁心堂」「权略阁」「劫变司」，各修其道。
萧素雪的隐忧：
她轻抚彩虹琴弦，测天丝梧桐叶突然飘落，叶面上浮现太昊玄渊的低语：「劫外福音，已种民心……」劫心琴自动奏出《采薇》变调，旋律中夹杂着百姓的哭号。
风九幽的新发现：
听潮阁的机关罗盘指向西北荒漠，那里的沙民正在崇拜一尊「劫外先知」：「根据傀儡传回的影像，那先知的眉心……有劫字棋碎片。
二、劫外先知·福音惑众
西北荒漠「沙罗天」突现绿洲，绿洲中央矗立着由恐惧凝成的「劫外祭坛」，祭坛上的白袍人抬手洒出黑沙，接触者皆露出痴迷笑容：
「吾乃太昊玄渊座下「福音使」，奉劫外之命，赐尔等——无惧之勇！
-技能·恐惧福音：
黑沙钻入百姓眉心，封印恐惧情感，却让其他情绪暴走：「不再恐惧死亡，便可不畏征战！
不再恐惧离别，便可不念亲情！
-百姓异变：
沙民们眼神空洞却战意滔天，手持骨刀砍向邻近城邦，刀刃刻着「劫外永生」字样。
云无心的七情洞察：
她打开琉璃瓶吸收沙民情感，瓶中七情之花竟全部枯萎：「他们的恐惧被强行抽离，剩下的只有……扭曲的狂喜与暴怒！
姜公望的民愿感知：

社稷锄插入沙地，却引不出半点愿力：「民心被劫外黑雾蒙蔽，老农的锄头……锄不动这心魔啊！
三、五派西征·净化之战
劫盟联军抵达沙罗天，眼前景象触目惊心：
-绿洲边缘堆满风干的尸体，每具尸体手心都刻着「劫」字；
-祭坛周围环绕着由恐惧凝成的「罪业之墙」，墙上投影着众人的失败过往。
元晦的佛魔之鉴：
「阿弥陀佛……这些人不是被操控，是自愿交出恐惧——因为他们厌倦了痛苦。
」佛骨舍利七色莲花升起，照亮罪业之墙上的「贪嗔痴」纹路。
content_en:
1. The aftermath of the calamity and the dispute between orthodoxy
At the inauguration ceremony of the New Tianheng Tower, a conflict broke out between disciples of the Confucian Qing School and the Machiavellian School over the interpretation of the "Benevolent Tribulation Sword":
-Qing school: "Benevolence and Taoism are the foundation, and the calamity technique is the supplement, so it can be combined with the orthodoxy of Confucianism!"
-The Machiavellian school: "If there is no calamity to deter people, how can benevolence be practiced?"
Shen Moqing pressed the hilt of the sword, and the bronze patterns on the Dao bone bamboo joints and the Qi Emotions Dao Heart Beads glowed at the same time: "The three colors of benevolence, power, and calamity coexist, which means that Confucianism and Taoism need to be inclusive - from now on, the Confucian sect will set up "Renxintang", "Quanlue Pavilion" and "Jiebian Division", each to cultivate his own way.
Xiao Suxue’s hidden worries:
She gently stroked the rainbow strings, and the Tiansi sycamore leaves suddenly fell, and Taihao Xuanyuan's whisper appeared on the leaves: "The gospel of the outside world has been planted in the hearts of the people..." The Jie Xin Qin automatically played the tune of "Plucking Wei", and the melody was mixed with the cries of the people.
Feng Jiuyou’s new discovery:
Tingchao Pavilion's mechanical compass points to the northwest desert, where the sand people are worshiping a "Jiewai Prophet": "According to the image sent back by the puppet, there are pieces of Jiezi chess between the prophet's eyebrows..."
2. The prophet outside the tribulation and the gospel confuses the people
An oasis suddenly appeared in the northwest desert "Saluotian". In the center of the oasis stood the "Altar of Tribulation" made of fear. The man in white robes on the altar raised his hand and sprinkled black sand, and everyone who came into contact showed an obsessed smile:
"I am the "Evangelist" under Taihao Xuanyuan, and I have been ordered by Jie Wai to grant you the courage to be fearless!
-Skill·Fear Gospel:
The black sand penetrated into the eyebrows of the people, sealing the fear emotion, but letting other emotions run wild: "If you no longer fear death, you will not be afraid of war!"
If you no longer fear separation, you can forget about family ties!
-Mutations among the people:
The Sand People's eyes were hollow but their fighting spirit was overwhelming. They were wielding bone knives and slashing at neighboring city-states. The words "Eternal Life Beyond Tribulation" were engraved on the blades.
Yun Wuxin’s insight into the seven emotions:
She opened the glass bottle to absorb the emotions of the sand people, but all the flowers of the seven emotions in the bottle withered: "Their fear was forcibly extracted, and what was left was only... twisted ecstasy and rage!"
Jiang Gongwang’s perception of people’s wishes:
The Sheji hoe was inserted into the sand, but it could not elicit any willpower: "The people's hearts were clouded by the black fog outside the calamity, and the old farmer's hoe... couldn't hoe away this inner demon!
3. The Western Expedition of the Five Factions and the Battle of Purification
When the Jie Alliance forces arrived at Shaluotian, the sight before them was shocking:
-The edge of the oasis is piled with dried corpses, and the word "Jie" is engraved on the palm of each corpse;
-The altar is surrounded by a "wall of sin" made of fear, and everyone's past failures are projected on the wall.
Yuan Hui’s Lessons from Buddha and Demon:
"Amitabha...these people are not being manipulated, they are voluntarily surrendering their fear - because they are tired of the pain.
"The seven-color lotus flower rising from the Buddha's bone relics illuminates the lines of "greed, anger, and ignorance" on the wall of sinful karma.
